description.value: HellCrust Pizza is a BC-born pizza franchise that sets itself apart through 'Biga' preferment dough — an Italian technique requiring a day or two of advance preparation — aimed at richer flavour and improved digestibility without chemical stabilizers. The brand has grown from 2 locations in 2021 to 18+ across British Columbia and Alberta, all franchised. The menu spans signature and vegan pizzas, pasta, wings, and appetizers, with online ordering and indoor seating available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms HellCrust Pizza is a live, active BC-based pizza franchise with 18+ locations. The menu page explicitly lists 'Vegan Pizzas (Made with Daiya cheese)' and online ordering confirms takeout capability. No website or OSM content addresses bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Vancouver' but coordinates (49.2105, -122.9344) place this location in New Westminster, BC — not the City of Vancouver.
Phone number (+1-604-527-1116) could not be confirmed from website; the contact page lists only an email address (info@hellcrustpizza.com).
Website footer uses 'Hell Crust Pizza' (two words) while OSM name is 'HellCrust Pizza' (one word); minor branding inconsistency, not a substantive concern.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active fast-food pizza business with a live website and confirmed franchise presence across BC. Useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a meal.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu page lists a dedicated 'Vegan Pizzas (Made with Daiya cheese)' section; cauliflower bites and other vegetarian-compatible items also listed. No GF mention found
